commentary.text: 90+4' Graham Scott is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
88' Substitution. Callum Hudson-Odoi walks off the pitch and Rodrigo Ribeiro (Nottingham) comes on as a substitute.
88' It is time for a substitution. Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham) is on for Anthony Elanga.
83' Substitution. Josh Cullen is replaced by Jack Cork (Burnley).
80' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to substitute Danilo and he is replaced by Moussa Niakhate (Nottingham).
79' Today's match ends for Chris Wood who will be replaced by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham).
78' The attendance for today's match is 21109.
75' Here is a change. Zeki Amdouni is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Jay Rodriguez (Burnley).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Josh Brownhill (Burnley) replaces Charlie Taylor.
72' 1 - 2 Josh Cullen (Burnley) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Matz Sels. 1:2.
70' A corner kick by Nottingham is thwarted by the well prepared Arijanet Muric (Burnley).
65' Yellow card. Maxime Esteve (Burnley) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
64' Nottingham get a corner.

62' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
58' We are about to witness a substitution. Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) is replacing Ryan Yates.

55' What a wonderful moment! Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) receives a perfect pass in the middle of the pitch, lines up the ball and unloads a powerful strike towards the crossbar. His effort fails to surprise Arijanet Muric, who makes a nice save.
55' The referee awards a corner and Danilo (Nottingham) goes over to take it.
55' Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The referee signals a corner kick to Nottingham.
53' Burnley seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
51' Great teamplay by Burnley as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jacob Bruun Larsen will be replaced by Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Vincent Kompany probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Lorenz Assignon. He is replaced by Vitinho (Burnley).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' So close! Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Burnley force a corner. They send men into the box.
43' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Charlie Taylor (Burnley), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
42' The ball possession is 67:33.
40' Burnley take a short corner kick.
38' Burnley enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
33' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
30' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Nottingham.
28' Maxime Esteve (Burnley) strikes the ball towards goal from distance, but it goes over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
27' Neat passing move from Burnley in order to create new attacking opportunities.
25' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
24' The current number of shots on goal is 0:2.
23' The Burnley players are exchanging some short passes.
18' Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
17' Graham Scott sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
15' The Nottingham players halt their celebrations as referee Graham Scott makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
14' 0 - 2 It is in the back of the net! Chris Wood (Nottingham) coolly beats the goalkeeper.
13' The Nottingham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
11' The ball possession at the moment is 81:19.
8' Burnley control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
6' The Burnley players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' 0 - 1 Chris Wood (Nottingham) receives a quality cross and unleashes an accurate shot into the top of the net and behind the goalkeeper.
